entities.name: Query ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: 315 aa soluble enzyme candidate with predicted molecular mass 34.6 kDa and pI 6.50.
Shows 50.3–50.6% identity and ~98.7% query coverage to reviewed bacterial ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinases Q81VZ0, Q81J97, and O33924.
Pfam predictions: Pribosyltran_N (PF13793), Pribosyltran (PF00156), and Pribosyl_synth (PF14572).

entities.name: Ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: Reviewed bacterial homologs are annotated as EC 2.7.6.1 and catalyze PRPP formation from ribose-5-phosphate and ATP.
Reviewed homologs bind two Mg2+ ions per subunit, are cytoplasmic, and form homohexamers.
Reference homologs map the reaction to Rhea RHEA:15609 and GO:0004749 ribose phosphate diphosphokinase activity.

entities.name: PRPP formation from ribose-5-phosphate
observations: Reaction corresponds to EC 2.7.6.1 and Rhea RHEA:15609 in the reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Magnesium dependence of ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: Reviewed homologs bind two Mg2+ ions per subunit; magnesium is expected to coordinate nucleotide phosphate groups during catalysis.
